flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob, helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper}, framework/schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, utilities/smsutility/SmsUtil, resources/{cron-schedules-prod.properties, application-{dev,uat,prod}.properties}. Other repos: not used. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ is not used as evidence.
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark: Vault & SMS Code Split, may need to check whether SMS permission is granted to the App Service. There is no flow deck. The SMS sending code exists and is the same as story OCMS11.4 (stage RD1), here for last stage RD2: batch to Postman2 via APIM, max 1000 per batch, template RD2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL[_COMBINED], notices combined per owner + stage + due date. Gaps: (1) cron.notification.enabled=false in dev/UAT/prod and in prod sms.enable=false with no sms.allowedSources so SmsUtil refuses; (2) the mobile refresh from DataHive/DOS is off (cron.enareminder.datahive=false); (3) combining does not cross different due dates; (4) the template text is in the DB and cannot be confirmed to refer to the 2nd letter. Vault, DOS and the SMS permission cannot be verified from repo. Tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed; waiting for the eNotification cron to be active).
recommendation: Claim partially (50%). The RD2 SMS code exists, but the eNotification job and SMS sending are switched off in the properties, the DOS refresh is off and the template text is not verified. Ask for proof that the cron is active, the RD2 template in PRD and the SMS permission.

steps.step: OCMS gets the latest mobile number of the individual owner from DOS (DataHive)
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo then refreshContactInfo per record (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188). For individuals refreshIndividualContactInfo reads the Singpass contact from DataHive and saves the new number to owner_driver (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2770). But the whole refresh only runs when cron.enareminder.datahive = 'true' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:92-93, 2325-2340, 2461-2485) and the value is false in dev, UAT and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48). So in the repo configuration the number used is the one already stored in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver, not the result of a check with DOS. DataHive is assumed to be the DOS of the story; that, the DataHive view content and the Vault permission cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: OCMS identifies the unique individual owners per batch so each owner gets one SMS covering their outstanding notices
steps.detail: combineNotices groups notices by recipient key I_<ID> + stage + due date, sums amount_payable and fills combinedNotices (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2151-2227; getRecipientKey 2230-2250; called at NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:191), so one person's RD2 notices with the same due date become one SMS (template *_COMBINED). Sebagian because the key includes the due date, so one owner with notices of different due dates gets more than one SMS; the ENA exception (not combined, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2169-2172) does not apply to RD2. There is no phone-number dedup at batch level (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:269-290). Same as OCMS11.4.

steps.step: The SMS lists the outstanding notices and refers to the 2nd letter reminder
steps.detail: For reminders, nextProcessingStage is set to the last stage (RD2) (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:174-182) so determineTemplateName yields RD2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL or RD2_SMS_INDIVIDUAL_COMBINED (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:459-476). generateMessages loads the template from the DB and prepareTemplateData fills noticeNo, combinedNotices, noticeCount, amountPayable, paymentDueDate, vehicleNo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:274-345 and 410-437); if the template is missing the SMS is skipped with an error log. The reminder query only takes notices without suspension, so a paid notice (suspension PS-FP) is not included. The template text is in ocms_template_store (DB) and is not seeded in the repo, so whether it mentions the 2nd letter cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: OCMS sends the SMS reminder/notification to the individual owner in the batch job
steps.detail: The job sends through sendBatchSms (Postman2 via APIM, max 1000 per batch, status polling, one retry if the whole batch fails) with source ENOTIFICATION; companies are skipped because they only receive email (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:280-292; NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1527-1535, 1611-1613). The scheduler skips execution when cron.notification.enabled=false (NotificationJobsScheduler.java:30-31, 48-52) and the value is false in dev, UAT and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236, comment: 'Disabled in PROD to prevent sending SMS/Email notifications'). In prod sms.enable=false also applies with no sms.allowedSources, so SmsUtil.sendBatchSms refuses source ENOTIFICATION (application-prod.properties:87; SmsUtil.java:401-410). In UAT ENOTIFICATION is in sms.allowedSources (application-uat.properties:82) but the cron stays off. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed) says the eNotification cron is still waiting to be activated. Real sending, the SMS permission of the App Service and Vault cannot be verified from repo.
